dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi! Do you have a minute? Let's talk about your habits.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ! duː juː ˈhæv ə ˈmɪnɪt? ˈlɛts ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈhæbɪts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I usually sleep only five hours, and I'm always tired.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ˈsliːp ˈoʊnli ˈfaɪv ˈaʊərz, ənd aɪm ˈɔːlweɪz ˈtaɪərd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: If you sleep seven or eight hours, you'll have more energy.
dialogue.reading: ɪf juː ˈsliːp ˈsɛvən ɔːr ˈeɪt ˈaʊərz, juːl ˈhæv ˈmɔːr ˈɛnərdʒi.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But I have so much homework!
dialogue.reading: bʌt aɪ ˈhæv ˈsoʊ ˈmʌtʃ ˈhoʊmwɜːrk!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I understand. And what about your diet? What do you usually eat?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd. ənd ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈdaɪət? ˈwʌt duː juː ˈjuːʒuəli ˈiːt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A lot of junk food. I don't have time to cook.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈdʒʌŋk ˌfuːd. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ˈtaɪm tə ˈkʊk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: If you eat more fruit and vegetables, you'll feel much better.
dialogue.reading: ɪf juː ˈiːt ˈmɔːr ˈfruːt ənd ˈvɛdʒtəbəlz, juːl ˈfiːl ˈmʌtʃ ˈbɛtər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Maybe. If you eat less junk food, you'll probably lose a little weight.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. ɪf juː ˈiːt ˈlɛs ˈdʒʌŋk ˌfuːd, juːl ˈprɑːbəbli ˈluːz ə ˈlɪtəl ˈweɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I'll try it this week!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈtraɪ ɪt ðɪs ˈwiːk!
